class.name: SteamLeaderboardPageOperation
class.description: A request started from [method SteamLeaderboardQuery.fetch_operation] can first resolve the board and then download the page. A request from an existing [SteamLeaderboard] starts at the download. Stopping the owning scope settles pending reads with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP].

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends local observation of the current stage. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when the cancellation was applied. The operation settles with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP]. Steam can still finish an already submitted download.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether this operation has a terminal outcome.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the same typed terminal result delivered by [signal completed], or [code]null[/code] while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Use [code]await[/code] to get a [SteamLeaderboardPageResult]. A settled operation returns its result immediately.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once with the typed terminal outcome after the operation has settled.
